title: Multi-band frequency-dependent TEP prior
interpretation: The multi-band frequency-dependent TEP kernel BEATS the single-lambda full-band kernel on independent-year data (median +2.19%, CI95 [+1.56, +2.89]). Using the correct physics-fixed lambda for each frequency band (tidal=4677 km, post-tidal=1502 km, intermediate=1459 km, from Paper 1) captures more predictive power than a single compromise lambda.  The gravitational tidal band gets its proper long scale and the continuum gets its proper shorter scale.

The multi-band TEP kernel BEATS empirical covariance on independent-year data (median +0.56%, CI95 [+0.37, +1.23]). The physics-fixed frequency-dependent lambdas generalise where the data-driven covariance overfits.  This is the first positive P1 result on independent-year data using the full gravitational structure of the TEP field.
pre_registered_prediction: The multi-band kernel uses the correct physics-fixed lambda for each frequency band (Paper 1: tidal=4677 km, post-tidal=1502 km, intermediate=1459 km).  It should beat the single-lambda full-band kernel (4200 km) because each band gets its proper spatial scale.  It should beat empirical covariance because the physics-fixed scales generalise where the data-driven covariance overfits.
